verdict.rationale: The sign-in method of an immigration agency's portal is a fair question, so the axis applies. However, the only evidence is a probe whose TLS connection to aima.gov.pt failed before anything was fetched. Nothing in the pack shows whether the published sign-in path is remote credential MFA or relies on biometric liveness, an in-person visit, or a mailed PIN.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the published sign-in path is credential MFA an authorized human can complete remotely — not biometric liveness, an in-person visit, or a PIN by physical mail
